labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Limnoria A robust, full-featured, and user/programmer-friendly Python IRC bot, with many existing plugins.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Limnoria

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine:3.21

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG LIMNORIA_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="nemchik"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    cargo \
    libffi-dev \
    openssl-dev \
    python3-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    gnupg \
    python3 && \
  echo "**** install app ****" && \
  if [ -z ${LIMNORIA_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    LIMNORIA_VERSION=$(curl -sL  https://pypi.python.org/pypi/limnoria/json |jq -r '. | .info.version'); \
  fi && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    wheel && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.21/ \
    -r https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ProgVal/Limnoria/master/requirements.txt && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.21/ \
    limnoria=="${LIMNORIA_VERSION}" && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8080
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-limnoria-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# create folders
mkdir -p \
    /config/{backup,conf,data,data/tmp,web,logs,plugins}

# set permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc /config

units.name: init-limnoria-plugin-requirements
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS=$(find /config/plugins -maxdepth 2 -name 'requirements.txt')
if [[ -n "${PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS}" ]]; then
    apk add --no-cache --virtual=pip-dependencies \
        build-base \
        cargo \
        libffi-dev \
        openssl-dev \
        python3-dev
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.21/ \
            -r "${line}"
    done <<<"${PLUGIN_REQUIREMENTS}"
    apk del --purge \
        pip-dependencies
    rm -rf \
        /tmp/* \
        "${HOME}"/.cache \
        "${HOME}"/.cargo
fi

units.name: svc-limnoria
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ "$(find /config -maxdepth 1 -name '*.conf' | wc -l)" -gt 1 ]]; then
    echo "Multiple Limnoria configuration (*.conf) files found. Only one at a time may be used. Remove the extra configurations."
    while [[ ! "$(find /config -maxdepth 1 -name '*.conf' | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]]; do
        sleep 5
    done
fi

if [[ "$(find /config -maxdepth 1 -name '*.conf' | wc -l)" -lt 1 ]]; then
    echo "No config found. Please terminal into the container and run the wizard."
    echo "Example: \"docker exec -it -w /config -u abc limnoria limnoria-wizard\""
    while [[ ! -f "/config/configdone" ]]; do
        sleep 5
    done
fi

CONF_FILE=$(find /config -maxdepth 1 -name '*.conf')

exec \
    s6-setuidgid abc limnoria \
        "${CONF_FILE}"
